description: Checks whether a URL's path may be crawled under robots.txt (RFC 9309): the verdict for a user agent (default: *, Googlebot, Bingbot, GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, Google-Extended and CCBot), the rule that decided it and its line, crawl-delay, sitemaps and the matching group's lines. Longest rule wins, allow wins a tie, * and $ work. No robots.txt means everything is allowed; a server error is a 503, not charged. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

url.description: A page URL on the site whose robots.txt is checked

userAgent.description: One crawler name to check, e.g. Googlebot (optional; default lists the common crawlers)

name: robots
title: Robots
